description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walgama South, Matara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820030
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property (property of deceased persons without wills) and providing detailed land registration information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, land extent, and certificate of title numbers. It falls under the Land Gazette category as it primarily concerns land ownership, titles, and property transfers through legal processes.
